LanguageData.RatkinQL_FestivalTree_Report: A group of ratkins arrives, chittering with excitement about an upcoming celebration.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_Greeting: “Ho there, {Interviewer_labelShort}! We've come to invite you to our coming festival. There'll be food, lights, and good company. You'll not see anything like it on the surface.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_OptGift: “Take this gift for your festival (20 silver).”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_Fest1: “This is the Hoarding Festival — we give thanks for full storerooms after the harvest. Any burrow with enough grain to last the winter can hold its head high.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_Fest2: “The Underground Bazaar is no mere market; it's a frenzy where trinkets, tools, and stories change hands under lantern light. You might trade a broken gear for a tale your grandkits will remember.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_Fest3: “The Phosphor Beacon Festival is for the lost. We light the glowing fungi so that any ratkin wandering the deep dark can find kin again. Every flame is a promise.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_Farewell: “We'll save you a spot by the big pot. Come when you can — the tunnels will be warm!”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Festival_MsgGift: The ratkin accepts your coin with a grin, tucking it into a small leather pouch. “The elders will sing your name during the feast — you've bought yourself a good word in Rakinia.”
